subject: black_king_bar
description_en: Active: Avatar  Applies a basic dispel. Grants %spell_reduce%%% magic resistance and immunity to reflected and pure damage. For the duration of the effect, any negative effect from enemy spells has no effect.   Duration: %duration%s  Dispel Type:  Basic Dispel
notes_en: Purchasing another Black King Bar will not reset its immunity duration.
Avatar duration is not affected by increases to buff duration.

subject: blade_mail
description_en: Active: Damage Return For %duration% seconds, return all incoming damage, increasing the percentage by %active_reflection_pct%%%.   Passive: Damage Return Everytime you are attacked, you return %passive_reflection_constant% damage plus %passive_reflection_pct%%% of the attack damage dealt to you.
notes_en: Damage Return is calculated before any kind of reduction.
Returned damage type is the same as it was received.
Damage done by this item is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

subject: blight_stone
description_en: Passive: Lesser Corruption  Your attacks reduce the target's armor by %corruption_armor% for %corruption_duration% seconds.
notes_en: Does not stack with its upgrades, Desolator, or Stygian Desolator.

subject: blink
description_en: Active: Blink  Teleport to a target point up to %blink_range% units away.   Blink Dagger cannot be used for %blink_damage_cooldown% seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
notes_en: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.

subject: blood_grenade
description_en: Use: Throw Grenade  Throw a grenade at the target area. Enemies in the area will take %impact_damage% damage on impact, and be slowed by %movespeed_slow%%% and take %damage_over_time% damage every %tick_rate%s for %debuff_duration% seconds. Radius %radius%.

subject: bloodstone
description_en: Active: Bloodpact  Increases Bloodstone's Spell Lifesteal to %spell_lifesteal_while_active%%%. Lasts %buff_duration% seconds.    Passive: Spell Weakness Aura  Enemy units take %aura_spell_vulnerability%%% increased damage from spells.   Radius: %aura_radius%
notes_en: Spell Weakness Aura does not stack with Veil of Discord's Spell Weakness.

subject: bloodthorn
description_en: Active: Soul Rend  Silences a target for %silence_duration% seconds. At the end of the silence, an additional %silence_damage_percent%%% of all damage taken during the silence will be dealt to the target as magical damage.  All attacks on the silenced target will deal additional damage equal to %proc_damage_heroes% if the attacker is a hero, and %proc_damage_creeps%, if the attacker is a creep. Provides True Strike for your attacks and attacks from your controlled units against the silenced target.   Passive: Pierce Grants each attack a %proc_chance%%% chance to pierce through evasion and deal %passive_proc_damage% bonus magical damage.

subject: boots
description_en: Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
notes_en: Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.

subject: boots_of_bearing
description_en: Active: Endurance  Gives +%bonus_attack_speed_pct% attack speed and +%bonus_movement_speed_pct%%% movement speed to nearby allies for %duration% seconds. For the first %bonus_ms_duration% seconds allies are immune to slows.   Radius: %radius%     Passive: Swiftness Aura Grants %aura_movement_speed% movement speed and %aura_health_regen% health regeneration to allies.    Radius: %radius% Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.

subject: bottle
description_en: Active: Regenerate Consumes a charge to restore %health_restore% health and %mana_restore% mana over %restore_time% seconds. If the hero is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.  The Bottle automatically refills at the fountain.  Hold Control to use on an allied hero.   Passive:  Store Rune Runes can be stored in the Bottle for later use by right-clicking them. Unused runes will automatically activate after 90 seconds.  Using a stored rune fully refills the Bottle.
notes_en: Bottle is shareable. Stored runes cannot be shared.
Using a stored Bounty or Water rune fully refills the bottle if the bottle was full when the rune was stored; otherwise, it refills two charges.

subject: branches
description_en: Use: Plant Tree  Targets the ground to plant a happy little tree that lasts for %tree_duration% seconds.

subject: buckler
description_en: Passive: Buckler Aura  Grants %bonus_aoe_armor% armor to allied player units.  Radius: %bonus_aoe_radius%

subject: butterfly
notes_en: Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.

subject: chasm_stone
notes_en: AoE bonuses from multiple Chasm Stones or its upgrades do not stack.

subject: cheese
description_en: Use: Fondue  Instantly restores %health_restore% health and %mana_restore% mana.

subject: clarity
description_en: Use: Replenish  Grants %mana_regen% mana regeneration to the target for %buff_duration% seconds.  If the unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.
